headlines.text: On this day in 2024, Killswitch wasted no time making an impression, debuting right in the main event, appearing on Collision, rated 7.63 ? a strong outing. Christian Cage's newly renamed henchman Killswitch (formerly Luchasaurus) helped The Patriarchy nearly overwhelm FTR and Garcia, but Garcia stole a roll-up win over Nick Wayne to close the show.
Rewind to 2021, when Fenix & PAC & Moxley made a statement, debuting in the main event as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.26 ? a genuinely great match.

On a Friday in 2023, back when The Elite vs. Hardy, Kassidy & Page clashed for the AEW World Trios Titles, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.85. For Hardy, Kassidy & Page, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. Championship gold always raises the stakes.

secondaries.text: That Saturday in 2024, Serena Deeb returned to the fold after a long-awaited absence after 16 months away, appearing on Collision.
That Friday in 2023, Brian Pillman Jr. returned to the fold after a long-awaited absence after just over 9 months away, appearing on Rampage.
That Saturday in 2024, Bryan Danielson vs. Hechicero delivered a genuinely great match on Collision, rated 8.27.
